problem_type: Original image-size expectation is lost on canvas cache recovery
symptom: After restart or cache eviction, an accepted image task no longer produces its original exact-size warning
direct_cause: CachedTask.expectedImageSize is in memory; rebuildCachedTaskFromPayload reconstructs provider routing but not original outbound pixels
class_root: Image-size evidence lacks a durable identity-bound receipt at the actual canvas admission/recovery boundary
affected_population: New asynchronous canvas images after restart
Legacy accepted tasks without reliable pixel evidence
internal_only_reason: Internal task persistence/recovery ownership; no provider-native size protocol change
invariants: Persist compiled outbound image-size evidence, not current catalog/taskextras guesses
Project/vendor/model/kind/task ID must match the receipt
A new explicit unspecified expectation differs from missing legacy evidence
Missing or corrupt evidence remains unavailable with requested:null
No image mutation, create retry or provider/quota failure reclassification

door_reduction.why_not: The original 7 admission/recovery doors remain. Post-fix expectedImageSize/taskImageSizeSnapshots/createTaskImageSizeSnapshotStore scan adds 14 observed pixel doors; two previously generated generic type/i18n owner doors complete scoped coverage. Canvas admission and recovery remain separate operations; Agent size readers are unchanged. Web bridge admission is explicitly excluded from HTTP pixel receipts.

generality_proof: All HTTP async image admissions use the same narrow pixel receipt; both direct query recovery and idempotent query-only replay reach the actual cache-miss owner. Receipt identity and explicit unavailable state prevent catalog/payload drift.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Persist and validate immutable project-scoped pixel-only receipts
Recover from durable original evidence, never infer dimensions

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both profile and no-mapping async creates admit through this function
Cache miss after restart and eviction uses this actual owner; taskSubmissionRuntime query-only replay also reaches it
Agent already seals pixels in its durable runtime-envelope, not canvas taskCache

recurrence.reason: Every restarted or evicted async image can lose in-memory evidence
same_class_scan: door-map admitTask recordOutcomeToPersistStore rebuildCachedTaskFromPayload getGlobalIdempotencyStore --roots=electron,src (7 doors)
door-map expectedImageSize taskImageSizeSnapshots createTaskImageSizeSnapshotStore --roots=electron,src (14 pixel doors)
Original size-contract door-map of desktopStrings.ts/taskTypes.ts identifies the two remaining generic owner doors
Read taskCache, taskAdmission, taskSubmissionRuntime, submissionLedger, idempotencyStore and eventLogRepository ownership

prevention.invariant: Original pixels or explicit unspecified are immutable and recoverable by exact task identity
prevention.failure_mode: No receipt, corrupt receipt, or identity mismatch yields unavailable; accepted tasks are not failed or re-created
prevention.strategy: Project-local atomic pixel-only receipt at admission plus lookup by the true cache-rebuild owner

legacy_paths.rationale: No replacement task state machine; existing volatile admission/cache remains a performance and routing layer only

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Reuses existing project resolution and atomic JSON writer; no dependency upgrade changes this ownership invariant

migration: Do not reconstruct old dimensions from recipes, events, catalog or extras. Old tasks without a valid receipt report unavailable. New tasks persist exact or explicit unspecified evidence.
residual_risks: Disk write failure cannot manufacture durable evidence; it warns without resubmitting and later recovery is unavailable
Live provider and packaged/platform verification are out of scope
Already-loaded hosts do not automatically receive source edits
